title: Drift Wood #34 · the bus schedule
logline: Wood pins the Greyhound schedule to the corkboard. Reference material.

panels.composition: Wood's bedroom. The corkboard. WOOD pinning a Greyhound schedule to it, between the crab flyer and the yearbook photo. GULLY on the bed with a maple bar.

image.prompt: a teenage boy pinning a bus schedule to a crowded corkboard in his bedroom while a boy in a backwards cap eats a maple bar on the bed

panels.composition: The schedule: SMALL WOOD → EUGENE → SEATTLE. Departures circled in pencil. All of them.
props: bus schedule with every departure circled

image.prompt: close-up of a printed intercity bus schedule with every departure time circled in pencil
image.notes: Route names may be lettered after.

panels.composition: The corkboard, close, as a composition: crab, yearbook photo, back page, bus schedule. A life pinned in four items. Wood's hand leaving the frame.
